index.title: Flamenco guitars
index.subtitle: Where the wood sings and the duende awakens
index.presentationText: The flamenco guitar is a type of classical guitar with nylon strings, unlike folk guitars, which usually have metal strings. It is used to play flamenco music.
modeles.presentationText: Here are the different flamenco guitar models.
